about_the_game:
PHANTOM is a Single Player Ghost Hunting game,

Locations Inspired by Real, and Unusual Places,
Like Pirate Ships and Cave Systems.

20 Different Ghost Types, with 3 Evidence Per Ghost Type. and 11 Evidence Total.

With a EMF Reader, Parabolic Mic, UV Light, Spirit box, Thermometer, and Camera as your main Evidence Items.

GAMEPLAY LOOP:

You explore, and investigate Haunted, and typically Abandoned locations.

1] Identify the ghost's Main Evidence to complete the
Main Investigation, via EMF, UV, And Parabolic evidence.

Then you can stick around to complete the
Side Investigation, via the ghost's Age, Cause of Death, Favorite Item, and Wall Writing.

2] Upgrade your Equipment, from longer EMF Range, Faster Player Speed,
Faster Thermometer readings, to even Speech-to-text for the Spirit Box.

Or Buy New Equipment. A Smartwatch to monitor your Stress, to a UV Tripod to light up a room.

Or Buy a New Map, Like the School, Diner, or Cave.

Level up, and repeat

STARTING EQUIPMENT:

  • EMF Reader - See the ghost throw an item, turn on a TV, or move some furniture?
    Chances are, it left some evidence there.

  • Thermometer - When a ghost is Haunting a room, the temperature may Raise, Lower,
    or in some cases even stay the same. May be useful for identifying where the ghost is.

  • Camera - Useful for finding Side Evidence like Wall Writing.
    May be useful for identifying many of the ghost's Traits as well...!

  • Parabolic Microphone - Allows you to hear many of the ghost's interactions,
    as well as their Main Evidence, Like Screams or Whispers.

  • Spirit Box - Useful for completing the Side Investigation,
    as well as identifying the room of a Inactive Ghost.

  • UV Light - Used to spot Fingerprints, Footprints, or Claw Marks from the ghost.

  • Flashlight - Lights up dark areas.

You can purchase, or find New Equipment to replace the one's above,
For example:
Instead of the UV Light, you can buy a UV Tripod, that auto-rotates to cover the room you're in.
or instead of the Flashlight, you can buy the UV Multi-tool, and toggle between Flashlight & UV Modes.

LOCATIONS:

The locations in this game are inspired by Real, and Unusual places.
From more Typical locations like a House or a School,
to more unique ones like a Pirate Ship, or a Cave.

There are currently 5 locations available, The House, School, Cave, Diner, and Ghost Ship.

OTHER THINGS TO KNOW:

I'm a solo developer, and this is the first PC game I ever worked on. nearly 3 years ago!

This game is, and always will be: Single Player Only!

this is a slower-paced, Investigation game, and not really suited, or balanced for multiplayer.
This game also uses some Lightly satirical content, like location names, and location backstories.
